newsitem.title: USA: American Bio to appeal NASDAQ decision.
newsitem.headline: American Bio to appeal NASDAQ decision.

text.p: American Bio Medica Corp said Thursday that its application for listing on Nasdaq's SmallCap Market was not approved, and that it intends to appeal the decision within 30 days.
The company said Nasdaq turned down its request for listing because the exchange believes it does not meet the total assets requirement of $4 million.
The company added that Nasdaq's decision will not impact its daily operations.
American Bio Medica develops, manufactures and markets rapid, low-cost and easy-to-use diagnostic kits for substance abuse testing and develops other biomedical technologies and devices.
